response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT cs.constructorId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM constructorStandings cs GROUP BY cs.constructorId) SELECT c.constructorId, k.nationality, c.cnt AS record_count, c.cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM c) AS difference_from_average FROM c LEFT JOIN constructors k ON k.constructorId = c.constructorId ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A 'record' is a row in constructorStandings; the average is the mean of per-constructor counts across constructors that have at least one such row (computed as a non-integer average).
Ties in the difference at the 10th place are broken arbitrarily.
